evidence_quote: Applications consisting of a short cover letter and CV, including your working rights and GPA/WAM, can be sent to: info@alluvium.com
employer_line: Alluvium Consulting is a staff-owned B Corp focused on catchments to coasts, with a Melbourne office on Wellington Parade East delivering urban stormwater, waterway and water-sensitive design work.
notes: Careers page states the group is always looking for people. Graduate PD hosted on alluvium.com publishes info@alluvium.com as the application inbox. Speculative EOI uses that inbox only; named Melbourne urban-water contacts recorded for evidence, not used as recipients.
